_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: List the sound vocabulary by UCS category...

description: Use this to browse the sound vocabulary or to offer choices before make_sound. Pass category as a UCS CatID or category, query as words, or nothing for the start of the list. Returns sounds with ids, UCS CatIDs, descriptions and WAV links, and every UCS category covered with its count.

category.description: A UCS CatID ('UIClick') or category ('USER INTERFACE', 'DESIGNED', 'CARTOON')

query.description: Words to rank by, such as 'coin' or 'whoosh'

name: list_sounds

categories.description: Every UCS category the vocabulary covers, with its count

matched.description: Sounds that matched before the limit

cat_id.description: UCS CatID, such as UIClick or DSGNWhsh

category.description: UCS category the CatID stands for, such as USER INTERFACE

description.description: What the sound is, in one sentence

id.description: Stable id of the sound; pass it back as id to get its code

name.description: Short name, as in the UCS FXName

page_url.description: The sound on the free web page, where a person can play it

subcategory.description: UCS subcategory the CatID stands for, such as CLICK

wav_url.description: Link to the rendered WAV, 44.1 kHz 16-bit mono

title: List the sound vocabulary by UCS category
